author: oneinwhite
quote:
This isn't just a bad GTA game. This is a bad game.

Ignoring the overwhelming technical issues on release. The game is mildly amusing at best, annoying at worst but boring most of the time. For some reason we are constantly being pushed and nudged against doing crime in a crime simulation game. Rather being forced to pick up groceries that we aren't going to eat, experience endorphinless exercise and watch paint dry. I'm surprised they don't constantly ping or penalize us for not wiping our digital asses. This isn't the sims or animal crossing, and if it was it would be a pale shadow of what those games do as well.

And why are some crimes off-limits now? Isn't the core and soul of the GTA games that they pushed the envelope. Some GTAs were cartoony, some were gritty and serious but when they came out the games had some primetime special about how they were going to turn your child into a psychopath. Where's even the faintest whiff of smoke like that for GTA 6? There isn't any. That's how you really know this series has been declawed, defanged and defeated.
